claim: The British takeover of 1815 was followed by the 1817–18 Kandyan rebellion and its suppression, demonstrating that the convention ended sovereignty without immediately settling political legitimacy or resistance.
bounded_by: The rebellion is an aftermath of the takeover; it does not retroactively turn the 1815 convention into a battlefield conquest.
notes: Supports the false-lead distinction between conquest-by-assault and political transfer followed by rebellion.
